shotgun.name: BRUNO
shotgun.description: stocky adult male survivor, red baseball cap, brown beard, blue work jacket over gray shirt, dark jeans, boots; short double-barrel SHOTGUN (never a rifle/revolver)
shotgun.attack: 4aim shotgun,5fire shotgun with small orange muzzle flash,6recoil

soldier.name: SOLDIER
soldier.description: brown-skinned adult soldier, olive military helmet, olive camouflaged fatigues, dark boots; compact belt-fed MACHINE GUN with visible ammunition belt

firefighter.name: FIREFIGHTER
firefighter.description: adult firefighter, red fire helmet, yellow turnout coat and trousers with reflective stripes, black boots; FLAMETHROWER connected by hose to red fuel tank on back, not a firearm
firefighter.attack: 4aim flamethrower nozzle,5emit a SMALL orange flame at nozzle only,6recover; keep full jet out of sprite because engine draws it

medic.name: MEDIC
medic.description: adult woman with dark brown bobbed hair, white medical cap with red cross, white field medic jacket with green undershirt, gray trousers, boots; red-cross medical bag in hand, no gun
medic.attack: 4open medical bag,5raise dressing with a small green healing glint,6close bag/recover

crossbow.name: LARA
crossbow.description: adult woman with long auburn braid, dark olive outdoors jacket, tan trousers, boots, wrist guards; large wooden and steel CROSSBOW held in both hands, visible bow limbs and bolt
crossbow.attack: 4aim crossbow,5release bolt with bowstring action (NO muzzle flash),6reload/recover

turret.name: AUTOMATIC TURRET
turret.description: small autonomous olive/gray machine-gun turret on stable tripod, ammunition box and belt, steel barrel. Mechanical structure, NO person, no head, no legs
turret.attack: 4aim barrel,5fire small orange muzzleflash,6recoil; movement columns1,2,3 repeat stable neutral structure, no walking

drone.name: COMBAT DRONE
drone.description: compact olive steel military QUADCOPTER, exactly four rotor arms, small underslung machine-gun barrel, cyan camera lens; NO person, no humanoid body, flying machine
drone.attack: 4aim underslung barrel,5fire small orange muzzleflash,6recover; movementcolumns1,2,3 subtle rotor changes but stable body position

tesla.name: TESLA TOWER
tesla.description: compact steel-and-copper TESLA COIL on broad olive equipment base, ribbed copper coil, steel terminal sphere, cyan electric insulators; NO person, no humanoid body
tesla.attack: 4charge cyan coil,5small cyan electrical arc at terminal,6recover; movementcolumns1,2,3repeat stable neutral structure

laser.name: LASER CORPORAL
laser.description: adult sci-fi survivor in white/silver armored suit, white helmet with narrow cyan visor, dark gray joints and boots; compact white-gray LASER RIFLE with cyan energy cell
laser.attack: 4aim laser rifle,5small bright pink/cyan muzzle glint,6recoil

titan.name: TITAN EXOSUIT
titan.description: massive yellow industrial powered EXOSUIT with dark hydraulic joints, visible adult pilot in small glass cockpit, enormous steel fists, heavy mechanical boots, cyan circular reactor on chest; NO gun

bloater.name: BLOATER
bloater.description: fat yellow-green undead, swollen belly, tattered ochre shirt, dark trousers, exposed acidic boils, heavy boots

hulk.name: SWAMP HULK BOSS
hulk.description: massive moss-green undead giant covered in reeds and vines, ragged brown trousers, huge fists, heavy feet, bog muck and glowing yellow eyes

grunt.name: INFECTED RECRUIT
grunt.description: green undead soldier in faded olive helmet, torn desert military fatigues, dog tags, boots, no gun, fights with claws

general.name: UNDEAD GENERAL BOSS
general.description: huge green undead military general, peaked olive officer cap with brass badge, tattered decorated military jacket, broad armored shoulders, heavy boots, no gun

frost.name: FROZEN ZOMBIE
frost.description: icy pale blue undead, frosted dark hair, torn light-blue parka with white fur trim, dark pants, ice crust on clawed hands and boots

yeti.name: ABOMINABLE SNOW BOSS
yeti.description: massive white-furred snow monster with ice-blue skin visible on face and huge hands, dark small eyes, broad shoulders and long claws, no human clothes

spitter.name: ACID SPITTER
spitter.description: lean sickly yellow-green undead with ragged purple hooded cloak, swollen acid-filled cheeks and throat, green saliva, dark trousers, clawed hands
spitter.attack: 4throat swells,5spit a SMALL bright green acid droplet just by mouth,6recover

digger.name: DIGGER ZOMBIE
digger.description: brown-green undead miner, battered yellow hardhat, dusty brown work overalls, heavy digging claws instead of tools, dirt-covered boots

splitter.name: SPLITTER ZOMBIE
splitter.description: bloated green undead with torn violet shirt and glowing lime fissures across swollen torso, dark trousers, oddly split hair ridge; no graphic gore
splitter.attack: 4body fissures glow,5claw strike with small lime glints,6recover

splitling.name: SMALL SPLITLING
splitling.description: small hunched green undead runt, torn purple vest and short dark pants matching splitter parent, small clawed hands, oversized feral head; small species, no gore

shielder.name: SCRAP SHIELD ZOMBIE
shielder.description: green undead road worker wearing faded orange vest, dirty hardhat, gray trousers and boots, holding large rusty steel road-sign shield with NO text

android.name: INFECTED ANDROID
android.description: green cyborg undead with half head in scratched steel plating, red LED eye, small antenna, torn dark slate uniform, metal hand, black boots

mutant.name: LAB MUTANT
mutant.description: lime-green humanoid mutant with luminous yellow boils, torn orange-gray laboratory containment clothing, one oversized clawed arm, dark trousers, non-graphic

astronaut.name: INFECTED ASTRONAUT
astronaut.description: green undead astronaut in white padded spacesuit with pale gray joints, transparent cracked round helmet dome, backpack life support, boots; damaged suit visible but no gore

colossus.name: CYBORG COLOSSUS BOSS
colossus.description: huge green undead cyborg with bulky dark steel plated armor, red reactor and LED eye, massive mechanical fists, antenna, armored boots

director.name: LAB DIRECTOR BOSS
director.description: massive sickly green undead scientist, torn long white lab coat over dark purple suit, cracked goggles, vial bandolier, grotesquely oversized but non-graphic glowing green hands

padChief.name: LAUNCH PAD CHIEF BOSS
padChief.description: huge green undead ground-crew chief in orange high-visibility launch suit, gray reinforced armor pads, black headset and helmet, enormous work gloves and boots

cosmonaut.name: INFECTED COSMONAUT
cosmonaut.description: green undead in orange padded spacesuit with transparent bubble helmet, silver twin-tank jetpack, gray gloves and boots; keep jetpack obvious in back/profile

xeno.name: XENO ALIEN
xeno.description: slender hostile insectoid alien with dark purple chitin, lime glowing eyes, sharp head crest, long clawed arms, digitigrade legs and short tail, no human clothing or weapons

pod.name: ALIEN BROOD POD
pod.description: grounded organic purple-black chitin cocoon with green glowing fissures and squat root-like supports; no face, NO human body or legs. Columns1,2,3 must show species-appropriate pulsing/crawling/undulation poses, never human walking.
pod.attack: 4seams open,5hatching mouth releases one tiny green larva shape near opening,6seams close

larva.name: ALIEN LARVA
larva.description: small segmented lime-green alien grub with purple chitin head, tiny mandibles and many short legs, NO human body/clothes, low horizontal silhouette. Columns1,2,3 must show species-appropriate pulsing/crawling/undulation poses, never human walking.

commander.name: INFECTED MISSION COMMANDER BOSS
commander.description: massive green undead in reinforced orange-white mission spacesuit, transparent bubble helmet, large silver twin jetpack, brass rank tabs, huge gray armored gloves and boots

lunarWorm.name: LUNAR WORM BOSS
lunarWorm.description: huge pale gray segmented alien worm, purple armored back plates, circular dark mouth with small ivory fangs and lime glow, thick curved body with ground contact, NO human torso/arms/legs. Columns1,2,3 must show species-appropriate pulsing/crawling/undulation poses, never human walking.

marsTitan.name: MARTIAN TITAN BOSS
marsTitan.description: huge armored alien brute with dark rust-red rocky chitin, massive shoulders and fists, glowing orange fissures, green eyes, heavy digitigrade feet, no human clothes

queen.name: HIVE QUEEN BOSS
queen.description: massive regal alien insect queen with deep violet chitin, large segmented abdomen, long crest/crown horns, lime luminous eyes and green vents, clawed arms and insect legs, no human clothes
